minimal_reproduction: const process = startProcess(executable, args, root, process.env)
cause: The local declaration shadows the global process binding during its own initializer.
expected_invariant: Postflight CLI inspect, template and offline export must start with an explicit inherited environment after a validated long run, without a model request or changed checkpoint.
related_controls: A successful child receives the explicit environment and returns captured stdout.
A nonzero child exit remains a failure with stderr retained.
A hung child stops at its finite wall timeout.
